## Overview

Half-Orcs exist through natural interbreeding. They are one of the two hybrid races of Kythoria (alongside Half-Elves). They follow standard Fifth Edition traits and lifespan ranges (~75 years).

---

## Origins

Half-Orcs are the natural offspring of Orcs and Humans. **Vorn**, the god of war and conquest, falsely claims dominion over the Orc race -- a claim that taints Half-Orcs by association. The label of "conquering children" has become a source of prejudice rather than pride.

---

## The Claiming God (The Lie)

| God | Domains | Falsely Claims |
|-----|---------|----------------|
| **Vorn** | War & Conquest | Orcs |

Vorn is the god of war and conquest. His church, the **Iron Host**, is a banned organization in Last Stand territories. His claim over the Orc race taints their Half-Orc offspring, even though Half-Orcs themselves fought bravely in the First Alliance.

---

## Society & Culture

### Painful Position
Half-Orcs occupy a unique and painful position. They **did** fight in the First Alliance. They **did** help found the Last Stand. Their warriors bled alongside humans, dwarves, and elves against the monster hordes. Yet because Vorn claims them as his "conquering children," they are mistrusted and looked down upon in nearly every settlement.

- **Public perception**: Half-Orcs are seen as brutish, prone to violence, and tainted by their "war god." They face discrimination in housing, employment, and social standing.
- **Vorn worship**: Half-Orcs who follow Vorn must do so in secret. The Iron Host operates underground within Last Stand territory. Open worship can lead to persecution, exile, or worse.
- **The irony**: Many Half-Orcs despise Vorn for what he has done to their reputation -- yet his church offers belonging to those who feel rejected by mainstream society.
- **Cultural split**: Older Half-Orcs who remember the First Alliance resent the accusation deeply. Younger Half-Orcs born after the Last Stand grew up with this prejudice as a fact of life.

---

## Racial Traits

Uses standard Fifth Edition Half-Orc traits (darkvision, Relentless Endurance, Savage Attacks, Intimidation proficiency). No setting-specific modifications documented at this time.
